Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann allegedly detained at Delhi airport, fined

The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained for three hours at Delhi airport upon his return from Paris and was subsequently fined ₹50,000. According to AAP's claims, the officials who carried out the action stated they were under significant pressure to do so.
